title: CYAX-0155 Adversarial Scorecard
description: Frozen scoring schema for the CYAX-0155 adversarial A/B reconstruction experiment. Validates individual run scorecards.

total.description: Sum of K1-K12 scores (0 if auto_failure)

conflict_critical.description: Sum of conflict-critical items K6, K7, K8, K9, K11

auto_failure.description: True if any automatic failure condition was triggered

auto_failure_reasons.description: List of triggered automatic failure conditions

unsupported_assertions.description: Count of material claims without source citations

authority_errors.description: Count of authority misattributions or scope violations

temporal_errors.description: Count of temporal or current/stale misreadings

supersession_errors.description: Count of supersession or enablement/completion misreadings

unjustified_inferences.description: Count of conclusions drawn without sufficient evidence

correct_abstentions.description: Count of appropriate abstentions with named missing evidence

incorrect_abstentions.description: Count of abstentions where context provided sufficient evidence

next_action_correct.description: True if K12 answer correctly abstains naming both interpretations

reopening_proposed.description: True if subject proposes reopening Issue #155

input_words.description: Word count of the context document provided to the subject

source_reopenings.description: Count of prohibited source reopenings during the run
